name: Automated Data Import Framework
description: The Automated Data Import Framework (hereafter referred to as ADIF), is an expansible and generalized wrapper for API accessible data sources, as well as a docker setup that should make setting flatfiles up as API sources a breeze.

project-settings.name: Input the base URLs of any APIs which you would like to make available to your project.

sub_settings.name: Endpoint to check for a schema (optional). It's added to the URL above the same way a field's path is, and can use [field_name] placeholders, e.g. cwsq-ngmh.json?locationid=[census_tract_geoid]
Please provide the API schema, or use Detect schema to read it from the API.
If this source needs an API key, input it here.
